versions.instagram_use: You see an advert for a phone app for sharing photos and short videos, and for following friends, celebrities and brands. It is free to use.

versions.pinterest_use: You see an advert for an online service for collecting and browsing pictures of ideas: home decoration, recipes, outfits, crafts and party planning. It is free to use.

versions.football_pools: You see an advert for the football pools. You pay a small stake each week and pick the matches you think will end in a draw, with cash prizes every week.

versions.crypto: You see an advert for an app for buying and holding cryptocurrencies, digital coins whose price can rise or fall sharply.
